adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, the 3rd parameter is `userId` and is serialized as `calcomUserId` in the POST body (`calcomUserId: userId.toString()`). However, in `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts` the call is `refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId)`, i.e., it does not pass `credential.userId` like the other integrations in this diff. On sharing-enabled deployments (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` + `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`), this would send the wrong identifier to the sync endpoint, potentially associating tokens with the wrong user/entity.
